metadata.title: Soul Trio Portrait with Swash Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A triangular portrait of three women with large afro hairstyles in pink halter dresses against a solid blue background, featuring ornate swash-heavy typography in the upper right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three Black women arranged in a pyramid formation. They wear matching pink halter-neck dresses and have voluminous afro hairstyles. The lighting is soft and directional, creating warm skin tones against a flat, medium-blue background. The top right corner contains decorative, interlocking script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between pink garments and blue background
Repetition of circular forms in hairstyles and swash lettering
Symmetrical balance with a central figure flanked by two profile-oriented figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tight pyramid cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face, positioned highest and looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves down to the flanking figures, and finishes at the decorative text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open blue space in the upper left and top margins.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown skin tones and dark hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue and pink; deep values in the hair providing strong silhouettes.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with thick verticals
Curvilinear paths following the circularity of the hairstyles
characterSpecificRedesigns: L and U characters feature elongated tails that cradle adjacent letters
V and E characters are nested within the curves of surrounding glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small serif for metadata, though primary focus is the custom display script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif aesthetic with decorative flourishes
Matches the heavy, rounded, psychedelic-adjacent curves

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of three Black women with large, round afro hairstyles. They are arranged in a pyramid: one central figure facing forward, two flanking figures in profile looking toward the center. They wear matching pink halter dresses against a solid, flat medium-blue background. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom decorative script in the upper right corner using a dark brown color. The lettering should feature heavy swashes and interlocking characters that echo the circular shapes of the hairstyles.

verificationChecks: Are the hairstyles voluminous and circular?
Is the background a solid, non-gradient blue?
Does the text feature interlocking swashes?

postGenerationChecks: Check for skin tone warmth and consistency
Ensure the pink and blue have a vintage matte quality
Confirm typography is placed in the upper right quadrant
Check that hair silhouettes are distinct against the blue
recipe.reuseFormula: Triangular Portrait + Afro Hairstyles + Pastel Halter Dresses + Blue Backdrop + Swash Script
